title: Auto Electrician (Heavy Vehicles)
salary_note: No salary given on the careers page — page must say 'Competitive salary'.
experience: Proven experience as an Auto Electrician, preferably with heavy vehicles or construction equipment
description_text:
Position Overview 
 We are seeking a skilled Auto Electrician (Heavy Vehicles) to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for diagnosing, repairing, installing, and maintaining the electrical and electronic systems of heavy vehicles and equipment, ensuring they operate safely and efficiently.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Diagnose and repair electrical faults in heavy vehicles and machinery.
 Install, service, and maintain wiring, lighting, batteries, starters, alternators, sensors, and electronic control systems.
 Use diagnostic equipment to identify and troubleshoot electrical and electronic issues.
 Repair or replace faulty electrical components and wiring harnesses.
 Perform preventive maintenance on vehicle electrical systems.
 Read and interpret wiring diagrams and technical manuals.
 Ensure all work complies with safety standards and manufacturer specifications.
 Maintain accurate service and repair records.
 Requirements: 
 TRC must have Pre-departure course certificate
 Proven experience as an Auto Electrician, preferably with heavy vehicles or construction equipment.
 Strong knowledge of vehicle electrical and electronic systems.
 Experience using electrical diagnostic tools and testing equipment.
 Ability to read electrical schematics and technical drawings.
 Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
 Technical qualification in Automotive Electrical Systems or a related field is an advantage.
